name: Why didn't my house sell the first time it was listed?

mainEntity.name: Why didn't my house sell the first time it was listed?

acceptedAnswer.text: Common reasons a house doesn't sell include an inaccurate listing price, poor presentation (e.g., outdated decor, clutter), inadequate marketing, or unfavorable market conditions. Our team at Realty ONE Group Evolution conducts a comprehensive market analysis and property assessment to identify specific issues and develop a tailored strategy. This involves evaluating comparable sales in areas like Miami Beach or Coral Gables and considering current buyer demand.
acceptedAnswer.description: Houses often don't sell due to incorrect pricing, poor presentation, insufficient marketing, or market conditions. A thorough analysis helps identify the root cause.
